vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Office Equation Editor Stack Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Microsoft Office 2007, 2010, 2013, and 2016 contain a memory corruption vulnerability in the Equation Editor component.
vulnerabilities.notes: Frequently observed in weaponized lure RTF documents used by APT36.

vulnerabilities.shortDescription: RARLAB WinRAR contains a code execution vulnerability when processing ZIP archives.
vulnerabilities.notes: Targeted by SideCopy against Indian defense personnel.
